items.question: Which antihypertensive is an ACE inhibitor?
items.explanation: Enalapril blocks angiotensin-converting enzyme. Losartan is an ARB; amlodipine is a CCB.

items.question: Losartan lowers blood pressure by blocking?
items.explanation: Losartan is an ARB blocking AT1 receptors; no cough (unlike ACE inhibitors).

items.question: Sacubitril/valsartan improves heart failure outcomes; sacubitril inhibits?
items.explanation: Sacubitril inhibits neprilysin, raising natriuretic peptides; combined with the ARB valsartan (ARNI).

items.question: In Wolff-Parkinson-White with atrial fibrillation, which drug is dangerous?
items.explanation: AV nodal blockers can increase conduction down the accessory pathway, risking ventricular fibrillation in WPW+AF.

items.question: The 3Rs principle in animal experimentation stands for Replacement, Reduction and?
items.explanation: The 3Rs are Replacement, Reduction and Refinement, guiding humane animal use (CPCSEA).

*PharmaCraft Daily - 13 Nov 2026*

🎓 *MBBS* (CVS)
Q: Which antihypertensive is an ACE inhibitor?
Ans: Enalapril
Why: Enalapril blocks angiotensin-converting enzyme. Losartan is an ARB; amlodipine is a CCB.

🌍 *FMGE* (CVS)
Q: Losartan lowers blood pressure by blocking?
Ans: Angiotensin II AT1 receptors
Why: Losartan is an ARB blocking AT1 receptors; no cough (unlike ACE inhibitors).

🩺 *NEET PG* (CVS)
Q: Sacubitril/valsartan improves heart failure outcomes; sacubitril inhibits?
Ans: Neprilysin
Why: Sacubitril inhibits neprilysin, raising natriuretic peptides; combined with the ARB valsartan (ARNI).

🏥 *INI-CET* (CVS)
Q: In Wolff-Parkinson-White with atrial fibrillation, which drug is dangerous?
Ans: AV nodal blockers like digoxin/verapamil
Why: AV nodal blockers can increase conduction down the accessory pathway, risking ventricular fibrillation in WPW+AF.

🔬 *MD Pharmacology* (Paper I: General/Experimental)
Q: The 3Rs principle in animal experimentation stands for Replacement, Reduction and?
Ans: Refinement
Why: The 3Rs are Replacement, Reduction and Refinement, guiding humane animal use (CPCSEA).
